main_body: wooden water trough filled with water
top_band: light brown wooden back rim (row 4), blue water surface inside opening (rows 5-8), and light brown front rim (rows 9-10)
evidence: Reading a vertical column through the middle from row 4 downward: row 4 is the back wooden rim, rows 5-8 show the visible interior water surface (4 rows), and rows 9-10 form the front wooden rim, making a 7-row top band with a 4-row opening. Below the rim, row 11 is a dark eave shadow, rows 12-13 are recessed front wooden panels divided by vertical posts, and row 14 is the bottom edge (4 front-face rows).

style.evidence: Although the palette uses 4 blue tones for the water and 5-6 brown tones for the wood, they are applied as uniform, unbroken 1px horizontal bands across the entire 28-30px width (rows 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11 have no horizontal variation at all) and flat single-colour rectangles on the front panels. Next to the Beodeul references with their wood grain dots and per-plank shading variation, the candidate reads as flat, banded, and mechanical.
